item.title: zero-downtime deploys, revisited
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: zero-downtime deploys is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Zero-downtime deploys shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

what works for me

item.title: what i learned about zero-downtime deploys
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting zero-downtime deploys wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Zero-downtime deploys shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
